fill.obs_text: The lexicon entries bear the grouping out for nearly every code. The codes of thought and plan are H4284 (thought, device, plan; 19 occurrences), H7476 (thought, Aramaic; 6), H7454 (purpose, aim, thought; 2), G1261 (thought, reasoning; 7), G1761 (thought, reflection, design; 4), G1270 (thought; 1), G1271 (mind, thinking; 1), G3540 (mind, scheme, design; 1) and G3053 (thought, reasoning; 1). The codes of what the mind makes or is troubled by are H4906 (figure, imagination, conceit; 1), H4209 (purpose, device, plot; 1), H1902H (meditation, plotting; 1), H5587B (disquietings; 1), H8312 (disquieting thoughts; 1), H4093 (knowledge, thought; 1) and H1697I (speech, matter; 1). The codes of a view held are H1843 (knowledge, opinion; 3) and H3820A (heart, inner man; 1). Two codes stand at the edge of the group: G3588 (the article; 1), which carries the noun in 1Cor 2:11, and G0991 (to see, look at; 2), whose use in Mat 22:16 and Mar 12:14 is the regard in which a person is held and not a view of the speaker. The codes that link the group to its usage are H4284, H7476, G1261 and G1761 for the thought, H4906 and H4209 for the device, and H1843 for the view.
